artworks.title: Rustic Scene (Scene rustique)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a rustic scene with a small roofed structure and a cluster of trees. The viewpoint is slightly above, looking down. The horizon is low with minimal details. It is characterized by detailed linear strokes creating depth and texture in the trees and structure. There are various shades of black and sepia in a monochromatic color palette. The scene features a path leading to the building with overgrown trees, and a hinted horizon line in the distance.

artworks.title: Sleeping Beggar (Mendiant endormi)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a person in a seated, curled-up position, resting their head on their folded arms. The person has a full beard, closed eyes, medium-length hair, and is wearing a long garment. The background features stacked stone blocks.

artworks.title: Woman of the Marketplace (Femme du marche)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly woman in profile sitting with a somber expression. She wears a hooded robe, and her hands are placed on a basket in her lap. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Thinker (Le penseur)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated with his head turned downward, holding a stick. He wears a dark garment and has wavy hair and a beard. In the background, there are vertical wooden boards, a hill outline, and a faint sky.

artworks.title: Along the Terne (Sur la terne)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: This print shows a landscape scene with a gentle slope on the left leading to a body of water on the right. The horizon is placed in the center, showcasing the blank sky and distant, flat terrain. Trees and shrubs fill the left side, tapering off to reveal sparse vegetation in the distance to the right. The print features fine, meticulous lines against the off-white paper.

artworks.title: Banks of the Loire (Bord de la Loire)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a low horizon line slightly above the center. There are dark, dense bushes with intricate brushstrokes in the foreground. Beyond the bushes is water, followed by lighter vegetation with delicate brushstrokes. In the distance, there are trees and a structure resembling a house. The background merges with the sky. The color palette is monochromatic, with various shades of black and gray.

artworks.title: Old Chateau (Un vieux chateau)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image displays a slightly elevated viewpoint of a landscape. The horizon is low, showing distant hills and fields. Dense foliage of trees is prominent on the right, with a structure partially concealed among them. The style involves fine lines and cross-hatching, giving a textured look. The color scheme is monochromatic, with black and gray tones on a cream background, highlighting the intricate line work.

artworks.title: Banks of the Adour (Bord de l'Adour)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with a calm body of water in the lower half. Tall trees line the horizon, depicted with delicate strokes giving an ethereal quality. The color palette is mostly light grays, creating a serene atmosphere. Bushes and undergrowth are textured with fine cross-hatched lines near the water's edge.

artworks.title: Blacksmith (Le forgeron)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper half of a person's body. The individual is positioned leaning forward with both arms resting on a surface in front of them, perhaps a table or counter. Their facial features are stern, with a prominent forehead and a long, full beard; the hair appears to be dark and somewhat bushy. The person is wearing an apron over their clothing. The background shows a richly textured wall or curtain behind them, with diagonal lines adding depth and texture to the scene. The overall composition is etched in a monochromatic tone, emphasizing shadows and light contrasts.

artworks.title: In the Pyrenees (Dans les Pyrenees)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image is an etching capturing a woodland scene. The horizon is indistinct, with tall, slender trees filling the vertical space. Detailed lines create texture and patterns, with a monochrome color palette emphasizing contrasts within the natural elements depicted.

artworks.title: Riverbank (Bord de la riviere)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a soft, continuous feel. Delicate, flowing lines suggest movement in the trees and grasses, with fine, parallel lines indicating texture. The color palette is primarily monochromatic, consisting of shades of tan and muted whites. Trees stand close on the left with their thin trunks curving gently upward, while vegetation on the right hints at a tranquil natural landscape.

artworks.title: Village (Un village)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a gentle slope. In the upper middle, there are buildings and vegetation. The foreground has detailed foliage, leading to the buildings on the horizon. Fine lines and crosshatching are used to create texture and depth. The coloring is monochromatic, with different line intensities for light and shadow effects.

artworks.title: The Prodigal Son, 4th plate (L'enfant prodigue)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint printed in bistre
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a figure crouched under a large tree, detailed with fine lines. The figure is dressed in simple clothing and holds a staff, engaged in an activity. In the background, there are hills and landscapes depicted with curving lines. The color palette is warm sepia, giving a vintage look. The artwork features etching with delicate lines and cross-hatching, creating depth. Light and shadow play across the scene, enhancing the details.

artworks.title: Near the Woods (Pres du bois)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with gentle hills in the distance, viewed from an elevated vantage point. The horizon is not distinctly visible. The scene is depicted in intricate and delicate etchings with a monochromatic color palette of light beige and soft browns. The style includes cross-hatching and fine lines to detail trees and the terrain. Trees are depicted with curved strokes for foliage, adding depth and movement to the scene.

artworks.title: Saint Maurice in Bourgogne (Saint Maurice en Bourgogne)
artworks.medium: etching on very light green paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketch with a low horizon. In the upper portion, there is a vast sky. The horizon line includes distant structures and trees, drawn with sparse lines. The landscape is minimalistic with fine, light pencil strokes showing hills and foliage. Close to us, there is a small building and a few faintly sketched figures. The color palette is monochromatic, using only light pencil on paper, creating a quiet visual impact.

artworks.title: Professor Huxley, 2nd plate
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a pencil drawing of a man facing slightly to the right. The man is seated and his facial features include deep-set eyes, a prominent brow, a straight nose, and a closed mouth. He has long, straight hair and is wearing a formal outfit with a collared shirt and bow tie. The background is plain, focusing on the man's face. The drawing is detailed with fine lines capturing the man's features and hair texture.

artworks.title: Landscape (Paysage)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape view from a standing position, depicting a natural scene. The horizon is subtly suggested towards the top right, with faint lines indicating vegetation or a distant feature. Trees are seen on the left and right sides with flowing lines denoting movement. The sketch-like style features soft, intermittent strokes representing leaves and branches. The color palette is monochrome with shades of gray and black on a beige background. In the distance, the scenery appears blurred, highlighting the focus on the close trees with textured trunks and foliage.

artworks.title: Fagot-gatherers (Les fagottiers)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures carrying bundles of wood in a windswept landscape. The scene captures a moment showing the figures carrying the wood through the windy environment. The wind is depicted through the bending trees in the background, their branches twisting and leaves fluttering. The use of cross-hatching adds depth and texture to the scene. The composition focuses on the physical labor and the elements of nature present.

artworks.title: The Death of Virginia
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: This drawing depicts a group of people in an outdoor setting with soldiers, figures, and barren trees. The composition features a central character surrounded by others, some of whom are armored soldiers holding spears, while others are dressed in classical robes. The landscape is rugged with rocky terrain and leafless trees. In the foreground, two cherubic figures appear to be interacting with large instruments or tools next to a tree. The figures are intricately detailed, showing a variety of expressions and gestures. The use of contrast between light and shadow adds depth to the characters and setting, emphasizing the dramatic atmosphere prevalent throughout the composition.

artworks.title: Bacchanal with a Wine Vat
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures gathered around a grapevine and wine-making scene. The drawing features various figures engaged in activities centered around wine and festivities. A number of figures are entwined with grapevines, while others appear to be serving or consuming wine. Among them, a bearded figure crowns another with grapes. The scene seems to take place outdoors, under a large vine-laden tree. There is a sense of revelry, depicted through the relaxed postures and the interaction between the figures. The detailed engraving captures the classical style, emphasizing musculature and drapery typical of this form of art.

artworks.title: Henry Monnier
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: The image depicts a monochrome illustration of a man standing. He is facing slightly to the right with his left hand in his pocket. The man has a rounded face, slightly upturned nose, full lips, short curly hair, and is wearing a dark double-breasted coat, trousers tucked into knee-length boots, and a high-collared shirt. The background is plain with sketch lines suggesting depth.

artworks.title: The Coiffure
artworks.medium: graphite with brown wash on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person's back, showing the upper half of their body. The person is positioned with their back towards the viewer, with one arm raised and the hand touching their hair, while the other arm is not prominently visible. Their facial features are not visible, but the hair appears long and slightly wavy, falling down their back. The person does not appear to be wearing any clothing. There are no visible jewelry or objects being held. The background is a textured sketch with diagonal hatching lines, suggesting an abstract setting with no distinct objects or scenery.

artworks.title: The Fitting [recto]
artworks.medium: graphite over black chalk on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: The sketch displays the upper bodies of two women with another figure seated with their back toward the viewer in the foreground. The central woman is in a slightly turned position with one arm bent, her hand resting on her opposite shoulder, and delicately drawn facial features with closed eyes and a gentle expression. She has an updo with a side bun. The woman in the background, standing slightly behind and to the left, is also in a similar pose, facing away from the viewer, presenting only the back of her head and her profile. They are both dressed in loosely fitted garments and there are no visible jewelry or objects being held. The background is minimally detailed with faint abstract benches or walls suggested by light lines. The drawing appears unfinished with visible lines suggesting movement or position adjustments.

artworks.title: The Fitting [verso]
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of four standing figures with their upper bodies visible. The figures are arranged with two in the foreground and two in the background. Their facial features are minimally detailed, and only the contours are shown. The two figures in the foreground have their heads slightly bowed. The figures in the background are positioned one behind the other. The figures appear unclothed, with outlines of their bodies drawn. There are no visible accessories or objects. The background is plain, suggesting an unfurnished room. A note reading "PH 32" is in the top left corner.
